raw.what_makes_this_different: Narma differentiates itself by focusing on the "Work Graph" and an "Enterprise Agentic Brain" that observes work patterns, detects employee intent and business value, and then automatically generates, deploys, and monitors AI agents for continuous, high-ROI AI automation. This goes beyond simple process mapping or individual agent deployment, aiming for systemic AI integration and optimization.
raw.thesis: Narma is a venture aiming to transform how AI-first companies integrate and scale AI automation within their operations. The core innovation lies in its 'Enterprise Agentic Brain' which goes beyond simple task automation to understand employee intent and business value, identifying where AI can genuinely augment human work. It's designed for AI-first companies struggling with the practical deployment and scaling of AI agents, offering a solution that observes work patterns, intelligently detects automation opportunities, and then automatically generates and deploys AI agents. The problem it addresses is the significant gap between the promise of AI and its actual, measurable impact and pervasive integration within complex business workflows. Many companies invest in AI but lack a systematic way to identify high-ROI opportunities, build, and continuously manage AI agents. Narma aims to provide this 'Continuous AI lift'. Given the description, the founder is likely pursuing a growth startup model, aiming for significant market penetration and scale within the AI-first enterprise space. From the intake form, this venture appears to be at the idea stage, with a detailed conceptual architecture but no mention of development or user acquisition. Narma positions itself as a critical enabler *within* AI-first companies, complementing their existing AI investments by providing a layer of intelligence and automation orchestration. It doesn't replace existing AI models but rather leverages them, sitting upstream to intelligently direct their application and downstream to deploy and monitor agents. This positions it as a foundational platform for AI operationalization, critical for companies looking to move beyond experimentation to enterprise-wide AI adoption.
raw.one_liner: Narma is an Enterprise Agentic Brain for AI-first companies to observe work, prove ROI, and deploy AI automation at scale.

raw.product_description: Narma is an "Enterprise Agentic Brain" designed for AI-first companies to identify high-ROI AI automation opportunities, automatically generate and deploy AI agents, and provide continuous AI lift. It operates in three layers: Observe (desktop sensors capture work patterns), Intelligence (a "Brain" detects employee intent, business value, and "drift"), and Execution (an "Agent Factory" with approval gates for agent generation, deployment, and monitoring). It leverages existing foundation models, focusing on the "Work Graph" to optimize AI intervention.

core_insight.if_wrong: If Narma cannot accurately detect intent and value, or cannot effectively auto-generate agents, then its core value proposition of continuous, high-ROI AI automation will fail.
